threshold_policy.abstain_reason: validation signals 14 < 31; validation frequency outside 3-5/week; 95% Wilson lower bound < 50%

joint_execution_policy.abstain_reason: validation executable trades 11 < 31; executable frequency outside 3-5/week

blind.policy_abstain_reason: validation executable trades 11 < 31; executable frequency outside 3-5/week

validation_integrity.rule: a blind window may be inspected once; any retraining or rule change after inspection converts it to a development holdout
validation_integrity.next_fresh_blind_requirement: use dates strictly after 2026-08-27 and freeze code before labels are inspected

height_survival_model.assumption: current-to-next uses candidate probability; later steps use training-only beta-shrunk board hazards

height_survival_backtest.warning: terminal height is right-tail capped and remains diagnostic until evaluated on a fresh blind period

threshold_policy.abstain_reason: validation signals 12 < 31; validation precision < 70%; validation frequency outside 3-5/week; 95% Wilson lower bound < 50%

joint_execution_policy.abstain_reason: validation executable trades 15 < 31; executed promotion precision < 70%; large-loss rate > 10% or unavailable; executable frequency outside 3-5/week; executed precision Wilson lower bound < 50%

false_strength_model.target_definition: official open gap >=5% and failed same-day promotion; auction gap is therefore a contemporaneous defining input

large_loss_model.target_definition: limit-touch proxy entry to following-session close after 0.30% cost <= -7%

segment_reliability_gate.rule: blind: each 2-5 board n>=20 and positive Brier skill; >=3 observed active states each n>=20 and positive skill; in-distribution n>=100 and positive skill

emotion_forecast_gate.rule: online as-of transition forecast coverage >=90%; each active state >=20 observed transitions

emotion_forecast_backtest.rule: n>=100, >=60 rows with >=20 same-state transitions, positive adverse Brier skill and positive seven-state log-loss skill; challenger needs >=60 prior causal forecasts, >=5% Brier gain vs Markov, lower log loss and ECE no worse by >2pp

data_integrity.historical_universe_source: current A-share code/name list via AKShare fallback
data_integrity.historical_collection_warning: current-universe free history cannot include delisted names; historical ST/name status is unverified

limitations: open confirmation fields may be unavailable
forum popularity is a risk-only optional overlay
daily execution labels assume a fill at limit after any OHLC touch and are an inferred upper-bound proxy, not tick-verified fills
